statements.quote: The investments we are making in cloud and AI infrastructure and devices will continue to increase our operating costs and may decrease our operating margins.
statements.notes: Forward-looking statement that cloud and AI infrastructure investments, together with devices, will raise operating costs. It gives no amount or share for AI.

statements.quote: Operating expenses increased $3.8 billion or 6% driven by investments in cloud and AI engineering and Gaming, including the impact of the Activision Blizzard acquisition.
statements.notes: The $3.8B is the year-over-year increase in total operating expenses, not the total and not the AI part. Cloud and AI engineering is named as a driver alongside Gaming and Activision Blizzard.

statements.quote: Operating expenses increased $1.1 billion or 4% driven by investments in cloud and AI engineering and commercial sales.
statements.notes: This is a segment-level increase; the passage does not name the segment. The $1.1B is a year-over-year change, not total opex and not the AI part.

statements.quote: Operating expenses increased $1.5 billion or 7% driven by investments in cloud and AI engineering.
statements.notes: This is a segment-level increase; the passage does not name the segment. The $1.5B is a year-over-year change, not total opex and not the AI part, even though cloud and AI engineering is the only driver named.

statements.quote: Research and development expenses increased $3.0 billion or 10% driven by investments in cloud and AI engineering and Gaming, including the impact of the Activision Blizzard acquisition.
statements.notes: The $3.0B is the year-over-year increase in total R&D expenses, not the total and not the AI part. Cloud and AI engineering is named as a driver alongside Gaming.

statements.quote: We will continue to invest in capital expenditures to support growth in our cloud offerings and our investments in AI infrastructure and training.
statements.notes: Forward-looking statement that capex will support cloud growth and AI infrastructure and training. It gives no amount or share.
